q.t: A family drives Delhi to Agra (233 km), Agra to Jaipur (240 km) and Jaipur back to Delhi (281 km). How far did they drive?
q.e: Add all three legs: 233 + 240 = 473, then + 281 = 754.

q.e: The trip is the difference between the end and start readings.

q.e: The ends and the middle pair each make 58 ÷ 2 = 29, so the numbers are 13, 14, 15, 16.
